q: Who are the core leaders of the Young Pro Ministry?
Sino ang mga lider ng Young Pro?
a_en: Our four core leaders are Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa (PJB), Darcy Amiel Sudiacal (Kuya Darcy), Princess Jean Laborte (Cess), and Ryan James Indangan (Ryan). Together they serve under the pastor to shepherd the family, equip young pros, and lead in disciple-making.
a_tl: Apat ang core leaders namin: si Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa (PJB), si Darcy Amiel Sudiacal (Kuya Darcy), si Princess Jean Laborte (Cess), at si Ryan James Indangan (Ryan). Magkakasama silang naglilingkod sa ilalim ng pastor para alagaan ang pamilya, ihanda ang mga young pro, at manguna sa disciple-making.

q: Who is the Young Pro pastor?
Sino ang pastor ng Young Pro?
a_en: Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa — fondly called PJB — is the Young Pro Pastor and Department Head. He shepherds the ministry spiritually, leading us in the Word, in disciple-making, and in caring for the family.
a_tl: Si Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa — na tinatawag naming PJB — ang Young Pro Pastor at Department Head. Siya ang nag-aalaga sa amin sa espirituwal, nangunguna sa Salita, sa disciple-making, at sa pag-aaruga sa pamilya.

q: What do the core leaders do?
What is the role of the core leaders?
Ano ang ginagawa ng mga core leaders?
Ano ang tungkulin ng mga lider?
Ano ang role ng leaders niyo?
a_en: Our core leaders serve under the pastor to shepherd and care for the family — building one another up in the faith, equipping young pros for real-world relevance, and leading the way in disciple-making through servant, shared leadership.
a_tl: Ang aming core leaders ay naglilingkod sa ilalim ng pastor para alagaan at aruga ang pamilya — pinapatatag ang isa't isa sa pananampalataya, hinahanda ang mga young pro para sa tunay na buhay, at nangunguna sa disciple-making sa pamamagitan ng servant at shared leadership.

q: How do I reach a leader?
How can I contact a core leader?
Paano ko makakausap ang isang lider?
a_en: The easiest way is to message us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com — a core leader will get back to you. You can also come to a fellowship and say hi in person; we'd love to meet you.
a_tl: Ang pinakamadali, mag-message ka lang sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com — may core leader na sasagot sa'yo. Pwede ka rin pumunta sa fellowship at magpakilala nang personal; gustong-gusto ka naming makilala.

q: Who is in charge of the Young Pro Ministry?
Who is the head of the ministry?
Sino ang pinuno ng Young Pro?
a_en: Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa (PJB) is our Young Pro Pastor and Department Head. The three core leaders — Kuya Darcy, Cess, and Ryan — serve alongside him through servant, shared leadership.
a_tl: Si Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa (PJB) ang aming Young Pro Pastor at Department Head. Ang tatlong core leaders — si Kuya Darcy, si Cess, at si Ryan — ay kasama niyang naglilingkod sa pamamagitan ng servant at shared leadership.

q: How many core leaders are there?
How many leaders do you have?
a_en: We have four core leaders: Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa (PJB), Kuya Darcy, Cess, and Ryan.
a_tl: Apat ang core leaders namin: si Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa (PJB), si Kuya Darcy, si Cess, at si Ryan.

q: How can I become a leader or serve?
Can I help serve in the ministry?
a_en: We'd love that! The best first step is to be part of the family — keep joining the fellowships and YPGTs, grow with us, and let a leader know your heart to serve. Message us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com and we'll guide you from there.
a_tl: Gustong-gusto namin 'yan! Ang pinakamagandang unang hakbang ay maging bahagi ng pamilya — sumama ka lang lagi sa mga fellowship at YPGT, lumago kasama namin, at sabihin sa isang lider ang puso mong maglingkod. Mag-message ka lang sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com at gagabayan ka namin mula doon.

q: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng PJB?
a_en: PJB is the nickname for Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa, our Young Pro Pastor and Department Head.
a_tl: Ang PJB ay ang palayaw para kay Pastor Jaymar Bagalacsa, ang aming Young Pro Pastor at Department Head.
